name: Eevee
tagline: An all-in-one EV charging app: compatible stations, availability, costs, trip planning and reports.
problem: EV charging information is scattered across apps.
solution: Combines station data, compatibility, pricing, trip options and issue reporting in one iOS app.
demo_moment: Team-described: plan a trip and see compatible stations along it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Brings scattered data into one place.

lessons: Aggregation is enough when the data really is scattered.
